public_supports.public_file: SurfacePressureVTK/DrivAer_<design>.vtk in Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/K7PWNJ version 1.0
public_supports.units_note: Owner statement (M. Elrefaie, 2026-08-18): PointData array p stores kinematic pressure in m^2/s^2 (static pressure divided by density) from incompressible OpenFOAM v11 simpleFoam with k-omega SST at U_inf = 30 m/s, rho = 1.184 kg/m^3, nu = 1.56e-5 m^2/s; the kinematic dynamic head 0.5*U_inf^2 is 450 m^2/s^2. Dimensional metrics may be enabled later under this convention.
public_supports.case_file_rule: case ID <ID> maps to SurfacePressureVTK/DrivAer_<ID>.vtk (prepend DrivAer_, append .vtk)

source_pins.benchmark_evaluation_status: CarBench is the reference surface-pressure benchmark for this dataset. Its evaluation code and models are not yet public (the repository currently publishes the benchmark description only); the official split files will also be mirrored there after the CarBench release. CarBench reports equal-point-weighted relative L2, which corresponds to this dataset's surface_pressure_equal_entity_rel_l2 diagnostic rather than the area-weighted primary metric, so published CarBench values must be recalculated before use as leaderboard rows.

public_supports.public_file: Dataverse WSS doi:10.7910/DVN/PCZYL4 version 2.0 and full CFD doi:10.7910/DVN/EEYHUA version 1.0
public_supports.owner_note: WSS surface files share coordinates with the pressure files but store points in a different (permuted) order; activating any joint pressure+WSS support requires a reviewed deterministic index-matching or resampling rule before it can be scored.

metric_definitions.label: Overall score
metric_definitions.description: Dataset-defined weighted composite score out of 100; the selected dataset contract declares its components, transformations, caps, and weights.

metric_definitions.label: Field score
